_comment: Agent bridge voi KBT CRM. url = goc public cua CRM (KHONG kem /agent) - prod: https://apps.kbt.global/api-proxy, local test: http://127.0.0.1:3002. secret khop env AGENT_BRIDGE_SECRET ben CRM - co the de rong o day va set env CRM_BRIDGE_SECRET thay the (khuyen nghi, tranh commit secret). Env override: CRM_BRIDGE_URL / CRM_BRIDGE_SECRET / CRM_BRIDGE_ENABLED=1. pullDays = cua so hieu nang (7-120). refreshHours = nhip pull cache. gate = chan re-list SKU refund cao (chi khi du mau minOrders VA effective refund vuot nguong; hoi phuc thi tu go). flash.minMarginPct = chi uu tien SP margin that >= nguong khi chon flash.
